description: Palette roles are anatomical candidates. Normalized body zones disambiguate shared skin/hide colors without repainting source pixels. Rule-based masks are reviewed in regions.png.

review.finding: Warm orange D3 skin colors had source role other. Explicit body color-role overrides recover exposed faces/arms/legs; cream hide is clothing. Basket remains other. Reinspect generated sheets before finalacceptance.

context_rules.rule: With view/activity only: explicit warm colors below the hair cap remain skin; one cardinal-neighbor expansion recovers warm skin shadows below the hair cap. No iteration or large body-area paint.
